notes.title: Raining Blood 1.0 is out!
notes.content:
[h1] Patch 1.0 — Blood Called for Change[/h1][p]It’s time to dive back into hell. This is the biggest update we’ve ever made — a true rebirth for [i]Raining Blood[/i]. From fully reworked systems to new bosses, environments, weapons, and an even deeper story, this update takes the war against demons to the next level. Azaus is back. Bloodier, more strategic, and with much more to lose.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]The New Rune System[/h2][p]The old upgrade system has been buried. In its place, [b]Runes[/b] rise — artifacts that grant devastating abilities, with effects that go far beyond simple stat boosts.[/p][p]Some Runes alter weapon behavior, firing multiple projectiles or summoning spinning blades and orbiting weapons that protect and slice through enemies. Others grant survival benefits — life regeneration, temporary invulnerability when hit, and even a chance to ignore damage altogether.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/7a79a5841905540f894a2ecbf45f640ef22c18c3.gif"][/img][/p][p]There are also those focused on pure destruction: critical damage boosts, instant kill chances, and auto-executions. For efficiency lovers, some Runes expand magazines, save ammo, or instantly reload your equipped weapon.[/p][p]The most exciting part? [b]Runes interact with each other.[/b] When combined correctly, simple bonuses can transform into absurdly powerful effects.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Blood Ritual: New Unlock System[/h2][p]To unlock Runes, you must pay the price: complete a ritual by killing a specific number of enemies. Once completed, you may choose one of three random Rune variations — and that choice will be locked until the end of the current station.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/e11bdd90f63e1ced4117a299246e660ed3b5a310.png"][/img][/p][p]This decision is final. But the right combinations of Rune variants can lead to divine results.[/p][p]Yes, Runes can still be purchased multiple times... up to a certain limit. The choice is yours — and so is the risk.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]Paths of Power[/h2][p]Each Rune belongs to one of the [b]Paths[/b]: Focus, Power, Time, Luck, and Balance.[/p][p]Stacking Runes from the same Path grants passive buffs. For example, having two Luck Runes increases item drop chance by 10%. The more you specialize in a Path, the stronger — and more predictable — it becomes.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/82728174a6cc60fdd88d979063557df153ff357b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/b067b400368a8cd5e2d948669e4df5db2be40e0c.png"][/img][/carousel][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]New Weapons, Elemental Melee[/h2][p]Weapons have been reinforced — and now [b]melee weapons are blessed (or cursed) with elemental powers[/b]. Get ready to slash, burn, freeze, and electrocute your enemies with stylish brutality.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2]New Interface[/h2][p]The HUD has been redesigned from scratch. Cleaner, more visible, and more functional. You’ll also see a health bar floating above your character, making tense moments more readable.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/0103d0f13a05160fc7c9342138d144564333dd67.png"][/img][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/f12a1a4113df9527c2cfc6bfd476b8a906a8dcb7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/949a89040cba9f2bfb2760cf96b17551ded12f77.png"][/img][/carousel][p]The Rune and Weapon menus have also been revamped. Navigation is faster, visuals are clearer, and information is easier to access.[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2] Skill Tree: 76 Reasons to Restart[/h2][p]We’ve introduced a [b]full skill tree[/b] with 76 unique passive abilities. Now, every choice matters. Each new run defines a unique playstyle. No two matches will ever be the same.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/da3d8d317fa9c67bd3e6390494443f97abb366af.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/106ac1f6b36e089f053a43798a6b60ee0d5598a8.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h2] New Environments[/h2][p]This update brings [b]four fully playable new maps[/b] — and a fifth one we dare not spoil...[/p][p][/p][h3]The Void[/h3][p]The player’s new central hub. A safe space between battles to change characters, talk to NPCs, and plan your next move.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/06576b76285089e519e9188b76f1d3b03363f981.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]The Catacombs[/h3][p]Dark and damp hallways where even the shadows try to kill you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/8445f6f4f4528f16cc2a003158c97d5f3d382356.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Hell[/h3][h3]Chaotic. Fiery. Home to your worst nightmares.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/b3682f5bceb1e7aa9af967cdaec6ed46c9082aca.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/fb4f9e2d72f72a966ca99659f6cb3209e49a9cea.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Stairway to Heaven[/h3][p]Redemption is made of steps. Many of them. None of them merciful.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/d1169fa952fafdf857ada1b765c7f4e5aed75b74.png"][/img][/carousel][p]

tags.feature: The old upgrade system has been buried. In its place, Runes rise — artifacts that grant devastating abilities, with effects that go far beyond simple stat boosts.

To unlock Runes, you must pay the price: complete a ritual by killing a specific number of enemies. Once completed, you may choose one of three random Rune variations — and that choice will be locked until the end of the current station.
Each Rune belongs to one of the Paths: Focus, Power, Time, Luck, and Balance.
Weapons have been reinforced — and now melee weapons are blessed (or cursed) with elemental powers. Get ready to slash, burn, freeze, and electrocute your enemies with stylish brutality.
The HUD has been redesigned from scratch. Cleaner, more visible, and more functional. You’ll also see a health bar floating above your character, making tense moments more readable.
The Rune and Weapon menus have also been revamped. Navigation is faster, visuals are clearer, and information is easier to access.
We’ve introduced a full skill tree with 76 unique passive abilities. Now, every choice matters. Each new run defines a unique playstyle. No two matches will ever be the same.
This update brings four fully playable new maps — and a fifth one we dare not spoil...
The player’s new central hub. A safe space between battles to change characters, talk to NPCs, and plan your next move.
Dark and damp hallways where even the shadows try to kill you.
Chaotic. Fiery. Home to your worst nightmares.
Redemption is made of steps. Many of them. None of them merciful.
Each stage now ends with an exclusive — and unforgettable — boss.
The Psychopato: a gangster duck guarding Heaven's gate with an egg machine gun.
Gael, the Betrayer: a fallen angel who now hunts exorcists.
Hells Bells: demonic bells that guard the catacombs where Lucifer fell.
Gorfo: a grotesque demon who throws boulders and screams like the world is ending.
Combat is now deeper with a new interactive elemental damage system.

Some elements work better against certain types of enemies. Water extinguishes fire. Electricity is stronger against wet enemies. Ice freezes, fire burns, blunt damage stuns, cutting causes bleeding... and it all stacks in real time.
Enemies with certain status effects have resistances and vulnerabilities. Using the wrong type might reduce damage. The right one might double it.
Each type of damage inflicts a unique status effect:
Enemies already under a certain effect can still take extra damage or resist further hits. For example: a soaked enemy takes almost no fire damage. But hit them with ice? Massive bonus damage.

The spawn system has been completely rebalanced. Difficulty now scales with surgical precision, with special waves every multiple of 5 (5, 10, 15…), where elite enemies appear to test all you've learned.

Necromancers

Bombers
Each has unique behavior and specific weaknesses.

notes.title: Biggest Update to date! V 0.9 is here
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes - Version Beta 0.9[/h1]

[h1]New Feature:[/h1]
[h2]You can now revive using your Demon Horns.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/46fcdcbb8fdecf2a6966d04ac88dbd91bd81286b.png[/img]


[h2]Reworks & Improvements:[/h2]

[h3]Physics Improvements:[/h3]

Fireball enemy bodies are now pushed with the force of the last shot.
Large larva bodies now have physics.
Improved physics for enemy body impacts: they no longer bounce like footballs.
Improved explosion physics: damage increases the closer the target is to the epicenter, and pushes enemies based on their distance from the epicenter. The player needs to be very close to the explosion to take damage.

[h3]Cemetery Gates Rework:[/h3]

Removed one of the purposeless gates.
Better weapons distributed in the initial area.

[h3]Weapon Improvements:[/h3]

Buffed grenade launcher: more bullets and larger explosion radius.
Improvements to all explosive weapons.
Upgrades to most weapons.
Buff to Azau's dash.
Buff to Azau's knife.
Buff to Big Iron: more damage, faster bullets, greater knockback.
Buff to various other weapons.
Reworked bullet physics on enemies: bullets now push enemies according to shot speed.
Bullets push enemies farther.
Applied bullet physics to flying enemies: flyers now recoil from shots.

[h3]General Improvements:[/h3]

Striker can now be upgraded at Caishen.
Damage numbers now appear with explosions.
Prices of doors and weapons shown in green when affordable. In red only when not.
Animation when earning more points.
Pop-up animation for hit indicators on enemies.
Floating text indicating the amount of points earned.
New players start the game with 10 Demon Horns.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

Fixed the bug causing OctoHead projectiles to move strangely when hit and when dying.
Fixed the bug with controller input when selecting the language on the first game launch.
More than 3 runes in the inventory no longer get cut off.

[h3]Gameplay Adjustments:[/h3]

Easy mode temporarily removed.
Faster pacing: new hordes start more quickly.
Different types of enemies now spawn at the beginning of the game.
More points awarded per kill.
Rain effect during multiple waves of 5. OctoHead now spawns in waves 5, 10, and 15.
Renamed Extra Ammo Rune to Extended Mag for better clarity.
